content: This paper presents a novel methodology for simultaneously performing feature selection and classification of functional data with categorical responses and longitudinal features, using logistic loss integrated with functional features to solve an optimization problem. The approach employs functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, demonstrating computational efficiency and effectiveness in high-dimensional scenarios, illustrated through simulations and real data analysis on chronic diseases and other factors.
